title: Add Ramayan and Mahabharat full kathas to the Katha section

requirements.text: Add a comprehensive Ramayan full katha entry to the backend Katha data store. The entry must include: title 'Ramayan - Sampurna Katha', category 'Puranik', deity 'Ram', full Hindi narrative text covering all major episodes (Bal Kand: Ram's birth and childhood, Ayodhya Kand: exile decision, Aranya Kand: forest life and Sita's abduction by Ravan, Kishkindha Kand: alliance with Sugriva and Hanuman, Sundar Kand: Hanuman's Lanka mission, Lanka Kand/Yuddha Kand: the war and Ravan's defeat, Uttar Kand: return to Ayodhya and Ram Rajya), and an English summary. The entry should appear before Mahabharat in ordering.

quotes: add Ramayan full katha in katha section

acceptanceCriteria: A Ramayan katha entry exists in the backend data with all major kandas covered in Hindi text
The entry has category 'Puranik' and deity 'Ram'
The katha is returned via the existing getKathas backend query
The Ramayan entry appears before the Mahabharat entry in the list

requirements.text: Add a comprehensive Mahabharat full katha entry to the backend Katha data store after the Ramayan entry. The entry must include: title 'Mahabharat - Sampurna Katha', category 'Puranik', deity 'Krishna', full Hindi narrative text covering all major parvas (Adi Parva: origins and Pandava birth, Sabha Parva: dice game and exile, Vana Parva: forest exile, Virata Parva, Udyoga Parva: war preparations, Bhishma/Drona/Karna/Shalya Parvas: the 18-day Kurukshetra war, Stri/Shanti/Anushasana Parvas, Ashvamedha Parva, and the Swargarohana Parva), and an English summary.

quotes: add ful mahabharat in katha section

acceptanceCriteria: A Mahabharat katha entry exists in the backend data with all major parvas covered in Hindi text
The entry has category 'Puranik' and deity 'Krishna'
The katha is returned via the existing getKathas backend query
The Mahabharat entry appears after the Ramayan entry in the list

requirements.text: Update the static fallback katha data in frontend/src/lib/kathaData.ts to include both the Ramayan full katha and Mahabharat full katha entries (matching the backend data structure) so the Kathayen page renders them correctly even when the backend returns no results. Ramayan must appear before Mahabharat.

quotes: add Ramayan full katha in katha section
add ful mahabharat in katha section

acceptanceCriteria: kathaData.ts contains a Ramayan katha entry with full Hindi text and all major kandas
kathaData.ts contains a Mahabharat katha entry with full Hindi text and all major parvas
Both entries appear in the Kathayen listing page under the 'Puranik' category tab
Both entries are clickable and open their full text in the KathaDetail page
The KathaDetail page renders the full Hindi text with narration support via the existing TTS hook

constraints: Do not modify any files listed under frontend.immutablePaths
Maintain the existing Katha data structure/schema used throughout the app
New katha entries must be compatible with the existing KathaCard and KathaDetail components
nonGoals: Adding any new UI components or layout changes to the Kathayen or KathaDetail pages
Adding English translations as the primary text (Hindi is the primary language)
Adding images or illustrations for Ramayan or Mahabharat
Adding episode-level navigation or chapter splitting within the katha detail view
